cohort: 1,174 women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean delivery who reached the second stage of labor
finding: Women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean delivery with a second-stage duration of 2 hours or more had higher odds of operative vaginal delivery, unplanned intrapartum cesarean delivery, and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean delivery with a second-stage duration of 2 hours or more had higher odds of operative vaginal delivery, unplanned intrapartum cesarean delivery, and postpartum hemorrhage.
